sourceReview: Every branch and helper reachable within this slice's boundary was traced against nethack-c/upstream/src/: readobjnam() and all five chain functions, wishymatch(), rnd_otyp_by_namedesc(), makewish()'s body, hold_another_object(), prinv(), xprname() and obj_to_let(). readobjnam_postparse1() was read end to end, which retires the earlier limit recording that it had not been. The trace covered state and random-number order and enumerated six draw sites inside the chain, each with the source condition that makes it out of scope. Stubs, stops and partial implementations were identified: js/zap.js's refusal where the slice starts, and js/mklev.js:1781's stand-in for readobjnam(), which this slice cannot retire. Two limits remain, recorded in candidateListMethod: name_to_monplus() could not be probed outside a game, and addinv()'s unconditional update_inventory() against C's suppressed perm-invent update is unchecked. This attestation covers this slice's boundary alone; the goal's remaining qualifier-and-class-word slice is not covered.
